author: Hank Green
description:
The video I posted on Vlogbrothers is at the end of this video, but you can also watch it here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fj-INVmmILo

Focus Friend is on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/focus-friend-by-hank-green/id6742278016

And Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.underthing.focus.friend&hl=en_US

If you are currently subscribed and want to move to lifetime, Apple has made this hard on us, but I'm pretty sure we've got a fix that will roll out with an update in the next 48 hours!

I was going to have you email us, but you shouldn't do that.
title: How to Make Things Matter to You
